declarations.description:
An "On this page" navigation for long documents. It lists the headings of the page (or of the element named by
`for`), nests them by level, and follows the reader: the section at the top of the scroll area is marked current
(`aria-current="true"`) and a sliding indicator moves to its link. Activating a link scrolls to the section, moves
focus to its heading and updates the URL fragment.

Headings are read from the page and re-read when it changes; a heading needs an `id` to be listed, its
`data-toc-label` replaces its text, and `data-toc-ignore` leaves it out. Pass `items` instead to list sections
yourself, which also renders on the server.
declarations.name: TableOfContents

cssProperties.description: `none` hides the title; it still names the navigation.
cssProperties.name: --c2-table-of-contents__title--display

cssProperties.description: Space between the rail and the text, and after the text.
cssProperties.name: --c2-table-of-contents__link--padding-inline

cssProperties.description: Added to the start padding for each level of nesting.
cssProperties.name: --c2-table-of-contents__link--indent

cssProperties.description: Entries above the current one, already read.
cssProperties.name: --c2-table-of-contents__link__passed--color

cssProperties.description: Size of entries below the top level.
cssProperties.name: --c2-table-of-contents__nested--font-size

cssProperties.description: Text before each entry, such as `counters(c2-toc, '.') '. '` for numbered sections (`c2-toc` is the counter of each list).
cssProperties.name: --c2-table-of-contents__marker--content

cssProperties.description: `0` removes the rail; set `__indicator--width` to `0` as well to remove the indicator.
cssProperties.name: --c2-table-of-contents__track--width

cssProperties.description: Fills the rail from the top down to the current entry, as reading progress.
cssProperties.name: --c2-table-of-contents__progress--background-color

cssProperties.description: How long the indicator takes to slide.
cssProperties.name: --c2-table-of-contents--transition-duration

cssParts.description: The `<nav>` landmark around the whole list.
cssParts.name: nav

cssParts.description: Every entry's `<a>`; the current one also has the `active` part.
cssParts.name: link

cssParts.description: The rail along the start edge of the list.
cssParts.name: track

cssParts.description: The marker that slides along the rail to the current entry.
cssParts.name: indicator

cssParts.description: The part of the rail from the top to the current entry.
cssParts.name: progress

members.name: for
members.description: `id` of the element whose headings are listed. Without it the page's `<main>` is read, or the whole body.

members.name: selector
members.description: Which elements of that element are listed, in document order. The level of `h1`–`h6` is its number; any other element's is its `aria-level`, or 1.

members.name: items
members.description: The sections to list, in place of reading the headings. Each needs the `id` of an element on the page.

members.name: label
members.description: Title of the list and name of the navigation landmark. Defaults to the translatable "On this page".

members.name: offset
members.description:
Distance in pixels from the top of the scroll area where a section becomes current, and where a link scrolls its
section to. Set it to the height of a sticky header.

members.name: keepUrl
members.description: Leave the page URL alone when a link is activated, for an app that routes on the fragment.

members.name: observing
members.description: What the MutationObserver watches: the headings of `observedRoot`, or the document for a `for` not there yet.

members.name: entries
members.description: The entries listed: `items` when set, otherwise the headings read from the page.

members.name: scrollToSection
members.description: Moves to the section `id`, as activating its link does.

members.name: spy
members.description: Marks current the last section whose top has passed the offset line.

members.name: lock
members.description: Holds the clicked section current while the page scrolls to it, so the sections passed on the way do not flash.

events.name: active-change
events.description: The current section changed, by scrolling or by activating a link. Does not bubble.
